title: Exclusions & Open Questions Walk
short_answer: Job Start requires What we did NOT sell and surfaces Jake's open questions for a reason. Walk them before the crew treats the whole floor as ours.
summary: Job Start requires What we did NOT sell and surfaces Jake's open questions for a reason. Walk them before the crew treats the whole floor as ours.
plain_words: The packet is not wallpaper. Read the exclusions out loud with the lead. Read every open question. If a GC asks for something on the exclusions list, that is Spotting a Change Order — not "we must have missed it." If an open question still blocks framing or hang, that is send-back / office work, not field invention.
when_to_use: Same morning as first mobilization, before the crew touches scope
After Ops accepts the Job Start packet
When a GC points at work that might be NIC / by others / excluded
prerequisites: Handoff PDF in the job's Drive Handoff folder
Lead and crew briefed on the same morning

steps.title: Open the Handoff PDF
steps.body: Read exclusions and open questions sections. Do not rely on memory of the bid meeting.

steps.title: Walk the areas named
steps.body: Walk exclusions (NIC / by others / no FRP scope / etc.). Photo the boundary if it will be argued later.

steps.title: Open questions
steps.body: Answered in writing, or still blocking? Blocking ⇒ call ops/office before mobilizing that scope.

steps.title: Brief the crew
steps.body: Name the three things we are not doing today — so helpful hands do not "just finish it."

steps.title: GC asks for excluded work
steps.body: Stop → photo → write → call. Same path as any verbal add.

warnings.title: Why GVC will stand behind this
warnings.body: Exclusions and open questions are required / first-class Job Start fields — the handoff contract, not optional notes. Scope-review clarifications become change orders when unread. This page only teaches the field ritual that makes those fields real.

quality_checks.prompt: Handoff PDF exclusions and open questions read aloud with the lead
Excluded boundaries photographed when scope lines may be argued
Crew briefed on what we are not doing today

common_mistakes.title: Memory of the bid meeting
common_mistakes.wrong: Skip the PDF because "we were at the precon"
common_mistakes.right: Read exclusions and open questions from the Handoff PDF same morning
common_mistakes.why: Verbal memory does not stand up in a scope fight

common_mistakes.title: Helpful finish on excluded work
common_mistakes.wrong: Crew "just finishes" NIC or by-others scope
common_mistakes.right: Stop → photo → write → call on the Change Order path
common_mistakes.why: Excluded work performed and never billed is free labor

common_mistakes.title: Field invention on blocking questions
common_mistakes.wrong: Mobilize hang while an open question still blocks layout
common_mistakes.right: Send back / office until the question is answered in writing
common_mistakes.why: Unread clarifications become change orders nobody wanted
